executionScope.scope: One independent German maximum group, not a rerun of all four combinations. Passing geometry/44pt/action assertions are separate from this visual verdict.

findings.observation: Decorative trash icon consumes the width of the long destructive label. Änderungen wraps as Änderunge + n verwerfen, leaving one final letter on the next line. The label is not missing and the action executes, but the new confirmation should not be marked visually accepted.
findings.suggestedMinimalRepair: Remove only the decorative trash icon from this appearance-discard action, preserving title/role/callback and shared component; independently review final German maximum rendering after the chosen fix.

acceptedScopes: Both large object panels show complete read, pin-or-unpin and cancel actions.
Long German deletion prompt correctly scrolls inside centered bounded card; three actual overlapping viewports cover full heading, explanation, cancel and delete.
Share error card fits complete heading, message andOK; appearance reopening restores classic and disabledSave.
Large Calendar displays full beginning and ending dates across actual scroll pair.
limitations: All10 unique original PNGs were actually opened with view_image;6 exact SHA256 duplicate captures reuse matching original review. No image altered.
This review does not equate200.712s automated Passed with complete visual Passed; the new discard label is explicitly rejected.
Existing very large menu/action/date icons sit close to labels; complete general icon-spacing polish is outside this placement/date-body scope.
Existing native Calendar header title crowding and Bear-/beiten wrapping are excluded from fullheader typography acceptance; original appearance theme-picker value also ellipsizes.
AssistiveTouch covers blank/card-edge pixels as recorded, which are excluded from complete visibility claims.
44pt hit targets, persistence, mutation and close behavior come from execution evidence, not pixel inference. Whole-App, all four combination rerun and pure manual performance are not claimed.
